content.description: Iteration 2: all iteration-1 specs were jammed (headways 1.6/0.85 s vs 0.39/0.30 s, queues 74 m), so shorten car-following headways, and raise red-running and early-start probabilities since the simulated shares were far below observed.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (sim 1.6 s vs obs 0.39 s discharge headway) and the M5/M6 jam (queues 74 m, approach times 100-260 s vs 12-40 s): all four iteration-1 specs kept Saval tau 2.5 s, which caps capacity far below demand. Lowering tau to 1.0 s, minGap to its bound 1.0 m and raising accel to 2.0 shortens headways and clears the queue; one coherent capacity change.

Targets M1/car (sim 1.6 s vs obs 0.39 s discharge headway) and the M5/M6 jam (queues 74 m, approach times 100-260 s vs 12-40 s): all four iteration-1 specs kept Saval tau 2.5 s, which caps capacity far below demand. Lowering tau to 1.0 s, minGap to its bound 1.0 m and raising accel to 2.0 shortens headways and clears the queue; one coherent capacity change.

Targets M1/moto (sim 0.82-0.88 s vs obs 0.30 s headway), M5/length (73 m vs 13 m) and M6 approach times: tau lowered 0.8 to 0.6 s, minGap 1.9 to 1.0 m, accel 1.1 to 2.5 m/s2 so motorcycles discharge faster at green and the queue does not spill; minGapLat stays at the 0.3 m bound for dense packing (M5/moto_density, M4/overshoot_share).

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (sim 0.0045 vs obs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (0.15 vs 4.36 veh/cycle): lowering p0 to 0.2 gave almost no red running because few riders reached the stop line during red in the jam; with the jam relieved, p0 = 0.5 (Saval) plus k = 0.1 (cap 0.8) raises the count and the variance/mean above 1 toward 1.31.

Targets M2/early/moto (sim 0.009 vs obs 0.13) and M2/first_delay (4.9-6.3 s vs 2.1 s): 93 of 177 attempts failed as red ended before crossing, so a higher p = 0.5 and a longer 8 s window (inside the 4-10 s target) give more early starters that cross before green.

Targets M9a (0.33 veh/cycle), M9b/share_blocked (0.02) and M10a (0.27 veh/cycle): values near the it01 s00 setting gave M9a 0.36 and M10a 0.21, so they are kept (p_sidewalk 0.02 to 0.03 for M10a); queue-at-choice should fall with the shorter queues. p_wrong_lane stays 0 (R27).

reasoning: Iteration 1 jammed in all specs: fix capacity via tau/minGap/accel, raise red running and early start.
